Medical History

  - Known hypertension (patient reports having high blood pressure).
  - Tobacco use: ~10 cigarettes per day for 15 years.
  - Alcohol use: approximately 7–8 pints of beer per week.
  - Low physical activity (patient reports generally does not do much activity).

  - No diabetes reported.
